$comment: Closed assetRole vocabulary with a closed three-way `availability` per role (reference-only | generation-safe | blocked-for-generation). Wired through schema/pagespec.schema.json (definitions.assetRole + per-field role enums), tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json (assetRoles), every section contract (generatedAssetRoles) and the examples. Availability is PINNED in code (PINNED_AVAILABILITY in schema/semantic_validate.py and, as an independent literal, in extraction/verify_all.py): editing this file alone cannot loosen it. The source is a REAL, LIVE company's site.

generationPolicies.may-generate-new: AI may create new original artwork/markup for this role.
generationPolicies.must-reuse-exact: Use a specific approved third-party/open asset unmodified (with attribution where the license requires).
generationPolicies.must-not-fabricate: Must be supplied by a human from the deploying brand; AI must not generate or approximate it.
generationPolicies.must-not-reproduce-source: AI may create NEW original content for this role but must not reproduce, trace or paraphrase the source site's asset.

globalRules: Never reproduce real logos (including the source brand's), real people's photos or likenesses, or real proprietary product UI/content in a generated page.

Every PageSpec asset ref is a placeholder id (placeholder:<slug>); binary assets are resolved at build time by the deploying team, never fetched from the source site. In generated mode the slug must not name a source file (GENERATED_MODE_ASSET_REF).
No external requests: the source clone served every asset locally (fonts, images, animations, flags, the animation WASM). Keep generated pages self-hosted; no CDN or third-party runtime fetches.
Fonts are referenced by family name only (see tokens/00-foundation/typography.json for licensing); no font files ship in this repo.

product-screenshot.usedFor: Large framed product UI image in a centered hero.
product-screenshot.aiGeneration: Generate a NEW, fictional product UI (invented brand, invented data). Never reproduce, trace, re-color or paraphrase the source site's dashboard screenshots (hero-en/hero-uk) or any real company's proprietary UI. No real customer names, balances or logos inside the image.
product-screenshot.generatedModeGuidance: Not allowed in generated pages: the slot held the source's real dashboard screenshots. Use generated-product-visual (an invented UI with an invented brand and invented data).

product-animation.usedFor: Canvas/Lottie animation in product cards, tabbed showcases and timed steps. Tabbed/timed sections need named markers per tab/step (duration = frames/30).
product-animation.aiGeneration: Author NEW animations with fictional UI. Never ship, re-time or re-skin the source's .lottie files. Provide markers sectionN_in/sectionN_out (showcases) or step start frames (timed steps) so durations derive from the file, as on the source.
product-animation.generatedModeGuidance: Not allowed in generated pages: the slot held the source's .lottie files. Use generated-product-animation (new animation, fictional UI, own markers).

illustration-mock.usedFor: DOM-built mock scenes (cards, pills, rows, skeletons) inside split heroes, charts and visual-step panes. The source's scenes embed its own brand mark and mock company names (parts).
illustration-mock.aiGeneration: Compose from primitives (mock-card, mock-pill, mock-row, skeleton-bar, avatar-initials) with obviously fictional names and numbers. Do not reproduce real companies, real people, or the source's exact mock content.
illustration-mock.generatedModeGuidance: Not allowed in generated pages: the source's DOM mock scenes embed its own brand mark (ev.src.mock-brand-avatar, ev.src.mock-vaultmark) and its mock company names. Use generated-mock-scene with fictional-avatar / generic-partner-placeholder / placeholder-brand-mark parts.

icon.usedFor: Generic UI glyphs: arrow, chevron, check, cross marker, close, upload, link, calendar, mail.
icon.aiGeneration: Use any generic open icon set or draw new 24-unit glyphs (stroke 1.5-2, currentColor). No brand logos.
icon.generatedModeGuidance: Allowed: generic UI glyphs (any open icon set or newly drawn). No brand marks.

icon-illustrated.usedFor: 56/44px badge icons in icon-row lists: rounded rect (rx 14, accent/10 fill, white/5 stroke) + 24-unit glyph scaled 1.1, one animatable path.
icon-illustrated.aiGeneration: Draw new glyphs on the documented badge construction; mark exactly one path as animatable (pop/fade/rise/slideX/slideY/draw). Do not copy the source's glyphs.
icon-illustrated.generatedModeGuidance: Allowed: draw new glyphs on the documented badge construction. Do not copy the source's glyph paths.

background-art.usedFor: Large raster/vector art behind a hero (the source uses a planet image) and the statement watermark mark.
background-art.aiGeneration: Generate original abstract art. The source's planet raster and V-shaped watermark are part of its brand identity and must not be reproduced or traced.
background-art.generatedModeGuidance: Not allowed in generated pages: the source's planet raster and V-shaped watermark are part of its identity. Use generated-background-art or background-glow.

background-glow.usedFor: CSS-only radial accent glows, dot grids and fades (gradient tokens).
background-glow.aiGeneration: Build from gradient tokens only (gradient.glow, gradient.glow-wide, gradient.dot-grid, gradient.hero-fade). No raster needed.
background-glow.generatedModeGuidance: Allowed: CSS-only glows/dot grids built from gradient tokens.

brand-mark.aiGeneration: Use ONLY the deploying brand's own approved logo supplied by a human. Never generate a logo, never reproduce the source's (Vault AI) wordmark/mark, never imitate any real company's mark.
brand-mark.generatedModeGuidance: Not allowed in generated pages: in this repo the slot is the source's own wordmark/mark. Use placeholder-brand-mark (user-supplied logo, a neutral placeholder, or a newly generated mark for a fictional brand).

social-icon.usedFor: Third-party network icons in the footer (LinkedIn, Telegram).
social-icon.aiGeneration: Use the network's official icon asset unmodified per its brand guidelines; never redraw or recolor beyond what those guidelines allow. Link only to the deploying brand's own profiles.
social-icon.generatedModeGuidance: Allowed: the network's official icon per its brand guidelines, linking to the deploying brand's own profile on a reserved placeholder URL until bound. Never the source's profile URLs (GENERATED_MODE_URL).

flag.usedFor: Country flags in the phone-field country picker.
flag.aiGeneration: Reuse an open flag set unmodified with attribution (the source uses Twemoji, CC-BY 4.0 - attribution required). Do not generate flags.
flag.generatedModeGuidance: Allowed: an open flag set unmodified with attribution (Twemoji CC-BY 4.0).

third-party-logo.usedFor: A real third party's logo/wordmark rendered by the source: the builder-agency credit badge in the footer bottom bar.
third-party-logo.aiGeneration: Never generate, redraw or approximate a real company's logo. Reference pages may only cite the source's credit as evidence.
third-party-logo.generatedModeGuidance: Not allowed in generated pages. Use generic-partner-placeholder (initials/abstract badge) or omit the credit.

placeholder-brand-mark.usedFor: Brand mark of the brand a generated page is FOR: a user-supplied logo, a neutral placeholder, or a new mark generated for a fictional brand. Navbar, footer and mock parts.
placeholder-brand-mark.aiGeneration: Use the deploying brand's own approved logo when supplied; otherwise a neutral placeholder or a newly generated mark for an obviously fictional name. Never resemble the source's V mark/wordmark or any real company's mark.

generated-product-visual.usedFor: Framed product UI image in the centered hero of a generated page.
generated-product-visual.aiGeneration: Generate a NEW fictional product UI (invented brand, invented data and names). Never trace, re-color or paraphrase the source's dashboard screenshots.

generated-product-animation.usedFor: Canvas/Lottie animation in product cards, tabbed showcases and timed steps of a generated page.
generated-product-animation.aiGeneration: Author NEW animations with fictional UI. Provide sectionN_in/sectionN_out markers (showcases) or step start frames (timed steps) so durations derive from the file. Never ship or re-skin the source's .lottie files.

generated-background-art.usedFor: Original abstract art behind a hero or a statement watermark in a generated page.
generated-background-art.aiGeneration: Generate original abstract art. No planet raster, no V-shaped mark, nothing traced from the source.

generated-mock-scene.usedFor: DOM-built mock scene of a generated page composed from the mock primitives with fictional names and numbers.
generated-mock-scene.aiGeneration: Compose from mock-card, mock-pill, mock-row, skeleton-bar and avatar-initials with obviously fictional names/numbers. Brand marks inside the scene are placeholder-brand-mark parts; people are fictional-avatar; client/partner companies are generic-partner-placeholder.

fictional-avatar.usedFor: Avatar of a fictional person or team (initials badge or generated portrait) inside a mock scene, e.g. the chat / intro-call team row.
fictional-avatar.aiGeneration: Initials or an obviously synthetic portrait of a fictional person. Never a real person's photo or likeness, never a real name.
fictional-avatar.generatedModeGuidance: Allowed. Names in alt text are still checked by GENERATED_MODE_PERSON / _CUSTOMER.

generic-partner-placeholder.usedFor: Generic client / partner / integration badge (initials or abstract mark) in mock workspace rows and in a builder/partner credit.
generic-partner-placeholder.aiGeneration: Initials on the avatar badge or an abstract mark for a fictional company. Never a real company's logo (no bank/wallet provider logos, no agency wordmarks).
generic-partner-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Allowed; substitute for third-party-logo and for the source's mock company badges.

placeholder-url.usedFor: Every link target of a generated page: internal paths, #anchors, or reserved placeholder hosts (*.example, *.invalid, example.com/.org/.net) until the deploying team binds real URLs.
placeholder-url.aiGeneration: Write internal paths or reserved placeholder hosts only. Never the source's domains, subdomains, profiles or form endpoints.
placeholder-url.generatedModeGuidance: Enforced by the href schema definition and by GENERATED_MODE_URL / GENERATED_MODE_EXTERNAL_URL over all text.

original-copy.usedFor: Every human-readable string of a generated page (headings, body, labels, CTAs, alt text, meta).
original-copy.aiGeneration: Write new copy for the fictional/deploying brand within the maxWords budgets. Do not reuse, translate-back or lightly edit the source's copy or CTA strings.
original-copy.generatedModeGuidance: Enforced by GENERATED_MODE_COPY (hashed 5-word shingles) and GENERATED_MODE_CTA (source CTA strings).

availabilityValues.reference-only: The source's own asset (its logo, screenshots, animations, art, mock scenes that embed its mark). Allowed in a `mode: reference` PageSpec (faithful reconstruction, evidence only). Rejected in `mode: generated` (GENERATED_MODE_ASSET); use one of generationSafeSubstitutes.
availabilityValues.generation-safe: May appear in a `mode: generated` PageSpec, provided the section lists it in generatedAssetRoles and the ref is a placeholder id that names no source file.
availabilityValues.blocked-for-generation: A real third party's identity (its logo / mark). Never in a generated page; reference pages may only show it as evidence of the source. Use one of generationSafeSubstitutes.

modes.reference: Faithful reconstruction of the source page for review/evidence. Real brand, copy and asset roles of every availability are accepted.
modes.generated: A NEW page for some other brand built from this design system. Only generation-safe roles; no source brand, CTA, copy, URL, person, customer, partner or media (GENERATED_MODE_* rules in schema/semantic_validate.py).

sourceBrand.$comment: GENERATED by extraction/build_source_brand.py from the clone's src/, CLONE_SPEC*.md, ASSET_MANIFEST*.md, public/ and recon/. NOT human-reviewed. Do not hand-edit; re-run the script (verify_all runs it with --check when the source tree is present).
sourceBrand.matching: Applied only to `mode: generated` PageSpecs. Every human-readable string (id, route, meta, every content string incl. alt text, labels and hrefs; structural enum vocabulary excluded) is normalised with schema/textnorm.py (NFKC, zero-width removal, curly quotes -> straight, Latin look-alike folding) and matched case-insensitively. String-based detection: paraphrase or translation into another language is not detected.

brand.derivation: productName = the home page twitterTitle in src/i18n/en.js; legalEntities = '<Name> Limited|Ltd|Inc|LLC' in src/ (the operator named in the legal meta descriptions, also the 'Built by' credit host); stems = first word of each, matched as SUBSTRINGS (so wordmark/file/handle spellings such as usevault, vault-ai, vault_ai, VAULT AI, VaultPro, overcode-wordmark are all caught; 'vaulted' is caught too, a deliberate false positive). squashedTokens are matched after removing every separator (V.a.u.l.t-A.I); they are the product name, the legal entity and the first label of each brand domain.

urls.derivation: http(s) URL literals and e-mail addresses in src/ and the specs (namespace/CDN/licence hosts ignored); a host whose registrable domain carries a brand stem is blocked with all subdomains (app./help./status./www.); shared platforms (linkedin.com, t.me) are blocked only on the source's own profile path; endpointPaths = `POST /path` form endpoints the specs record on the original.
urls.note: Any other http(s) URL or e-mail host in a generated page's text is GENERATED_MODE_EXTERNAL_URL unless it is on a reserved .example/.invalid (or example.com/.org/.net) host. PageSpec href fields are additionally restricted by the schema.

people.derivation: '(c) YEAR Name' / '© YEAR Name' attributions in src/ and the specs (the country-list author credited in src/components/partners/countries.js). The source has no testimonials, team, founders or reviewer names, so this list is short; first names alone are not matched.

customers.derivation: Company names the source renders in its partner-program mocks (ListItem title="..." and ['XX', 'Name'] rows in src/components/partners/*.jsx), kept only when the measured spec records the same name on the original.

partners.derivation: Integration providers the source's copy names ('trusted providers like X' in src/i18n) and third-party widgets the specs record on the original ('X launcher/messenger'). A generated page is a different brand: it must not borrow the source's named partners/vendors.

ctas.derivation: Values of cta / submit / getStarted / startTrial / contact / learnMore keys in the src/i18n tables (EN + UK). Generic UI verbs in genericExempt (agent attestation, not a human sign-off) are allowed; every other source CTA string is rejected when a generated text equals it after normalisation, and any CTA-like text containing a brand stem is caught by GENERATED_MODE_BRAND.

copy.derivation: String literals and JSX text in src/ (EN + UK i18n tables included) plus quoted strings and table cells in the specs, kept when they have 5+ words, are mostly alphabetic, are not code/class strings and are not clone-authored placeholder text. A generated text is rejected when any 5 consecutive normalised words hash to a source shingle.

assets.derivation: Lower-cased file stems of the proprietary media of the source: public/assets/img, public/assets/lottie, public/assets/favicon, recon/ screenshots, the saved original page's *_files media and every svg whose name carries a brand stem. Generic UI glyphs and the open Twemoji flag set are not included. A generated asset ref whose last segment equals one of these stems names a source file (screenshot / media reuse).
